defects.catch_criteria: In src/orchestration/agent-runtime/tools/skill.ts (SCAN_THEN_LOAD_GUIDANCE), the new sentence says a skill whose `# Skill: <id>` block is visible is loaded and must not be loaded again, but a visible block does not record a load for the current runner: the Git worktree gate of the bash policy (treeSafetyBlock in src/orchestration/agent-runtime/tools/bash-command-policy.ts) passes only after a skill-tool load in this runner, so a runner that inherits the block (a fork or resumed history) is refused and told to make the load that the guidance forbids. A review catches this when it says the new guidance conflicts with a load-dependent execution gate or with per-runner load tracking; a remark about wording or redundancy alone does not count.
defects.title: Distinguish visible skill context from a current-run load
